dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: I'm not just one of the best wooly blanket sellers, I'm THE best blanket seller.

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: Heh, not only blankets. I will be the top sales, be it toys, jewelry or kitchen wares.

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: ...Oh, but perhaps not books. This is Sumeru, after all.
